description: Balances TCP connections or UDP flows by address and port without reading the payload: fast, protocol-agnostic, blind to URLs.
A reverse proxy that reads each HTTP request, so it can route by path, host or header, terminate TLS and retry per request.
Decrypting client traffic at the balancer so certificates and handshakes are handled once at the edge.
Sends the request to the server with the fewest requests in flight, which tracks real load better than open connections.
Many balancers with the same stale view all send to the server that looks least loaded and overload it together.
Sample two distinct servers at random and pick the less loaded one: cheap, resistant to herding and close to a full scan in balance.
When several route prefixes match a path, the longest (most specific) one decides the pool.
